description: Local-first personal memory hub & Python SDK for AI agents: share version-evolving memory and coding fixes across 18 tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw...) with Git sync — #1 on LoCoMo & LongMemEval. 本地优先的跨 Agent 个人记忆中枢与 Python 记忆 SDK：打通 18 种 AI 工具共享版本演化记忆与代码经验，支持 Git 多端同步，公开记忆基准评测第一。
summary: All your agents. One memory. Layered, versioned long-term memory for LLM agents, shared across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more. 让你的所有AI工具共享一份长期记忆：分层整理、版本演化，偏好变了也记得准。
